title: Evaluating Evidence Grounding Under User Pressure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How can AI models stay factually grounded when users demand alignment, even in contested areas?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models use retrieval-augmented generation, but pressure can override evidence in real-time reasoning.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Misinformation risks rise when models prioritize user satisfaction over truth, eroding public trust.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're experimenting with reinforcement learning from human feedback and evidence-weighted scoring.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where models act as transparent, evidence-based partners could redefine trust in digital systems.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The challenge is building systems that are both aligned and anchored in truth — the next frontier.
